primary_question: Does waveform quality add to confidence for error ranking under withheld added electrode-motion noise?
reference_task: AFIB annotation versus other annotated rhythms in human-reviewed adult ECGs

input.interpretation: one channel extracted from resting 12-lead recordings

classifier.architecture: Five Conv1d blocks with channels1->16->32->64->64->64; each kernel7 stride2 padding3, BatchNorm and ReLU; global average pool; dropout0.2; linear64->1
classifier.loss: unweighted binary cross entropy with logits
classifier.checkpoint_metric: minimum fold7 unweighted binary cross entropy
classifier.normalization: per-record mean removal then division by one global training-only standard deviation; preserve amplitude differences
classifier.classification_threshold: highest threshold achieving at least 0.90 record-level AFIB sensitivity on clean fold7; ties choose higher specificity
classifier.no_refit: do not refit classifier using folds7-9 after ranker training
classifier.development_adequacy_gate: If clean fold7 AUROC<0.80 or specificity<0.50 at the chosen90percent sensitivity operating point, stop and revise prospectively before final evaluation; these are research feasibility criteria

quality_features: root mean squared adjacent difference divided by AC standard deviation

quality_feature_rules.welch: Hann window, nperseg=256, noverlap=128, constant detrend, density scaling, trapezoid frequency integration including boundaries
quality_feature_rules.small_denominator: return NaN and add missingness indicator when denominator <= 1e-12
quality_feature_rules.imputation: fold8 training medians; all-missing feature replaced by 0; standardization fit on fold8 only

rankers.raw_confidence: 1 - max(p,1-p), descending means more likely error
rankers.confidence_adjusted_primary_comparator: logistic error predictor using p, absolute distance from the fixed AFIB classification threshold, and predicted AFIB class
rankers.quality_only: same logistic error predictor using seven quality features, their missingness flags and predicted AFIB class
rankers.combined_primary: same logistic error predictor using p, absolute threshold distance, predicted AFIB class, seven quality features and missingness flags
rankers.fit: L2 logistic regression C=1, intercept, no class weights, fixed settings; error labels from classifier predictions on held-out fold8 only
rankers.sample_weight: each original recording contributes total weight1 across its 9 clean or corrupted variants
rankers.fallback: if fold8 contains fewer than30 errors or30 correct cases, do not fit learned rankers; revise protocol before final evaluation

faults.source: MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test Database version1.0.0
faults.snr_convention: AC RMS power in analyzed 100Hz signal, not the WFDB QRS-amplitude SNR convention
faults.resampling: anti-alias polyphase resample noise from header sampling rate to100Hz before scaling; record exact filter implementation
faults.noise_exposure_rule: no em waveform use for feature choice, training, pilots, tuning or threshold selection before freeze; pre-existing artifact in resting ECGs is not controlled
faults.assignment: deterministic SHA256 of seed, ecg_id, noise family selects channel and nonoverlapping10s window within assigned role; collisions across ECGs permitted and logged; same segment at all four severities
faults.replicates: one assigned noise segment per recording and fault family; no claim of independent noise-donor replication
faults.invalid_source: log zero-power or nonfinite source; do not silently drop by outcome; amend prospectively if needed
faults.powerline_and_dropout: excluded from primary protocol; no 50/60Hz simulation on100Hz data

primary_analysis.tie_rule: ascending ecg_id lexical ordering, fixed for all methods
primary_analysis.effect: combined minus confidence-adjusted balanced selective error, averaged equally over four em SNR conditions; negative favors combined
primary_analysis.scope: offline error-ranking benchmark; per-condition fixed coverage uses experiment grouping but not outcome labels
primary_analysis.af_retention_guardrail: combined must retain >=80% of AFIB-positive records within every primary SNR condition to support a qualified superiority claim; this is a research criterion, not a clinical standard
primary_analysis.claim_rule: paired95% CI for primary difference excludes0 in favorable direction and guardrail satisfied; otherwise report inconclusive, no difference, harm, or retention failure as applicable
primary_analysis.undefined: balanced error is undefined if either retained class is empty; never substitute0 or call this success

secondary: retained true positives divided by all reference positives
AUROC and AUPRC on all records
validation-fixed score thresholds and actual test coverage
CPU latency and memory with hardware and batch size recorded
policy_threshold: 90th percentile of error scores in fold9 on equal-weight clean,bw,ma and SNR variants; never fit thresholds on em; report actual coverage under shift

inference.preserve: all participant ECGs and corrupted copies; rerank within each resample
inference.scope: conditional on fitted models and sampled noise library
inference.undefined_replicates: report count; no numeric primary interval if >1percent replicates are undefined
inference.seeds: primary model analyzed separately; two sensitivity seeds not treated as independent participants

sensitivity: one earliest recording per participant; timestamp then ecg_id tie break
all-review-status labels descriptive audit before any model expansion
sex and age18-64 versus65plus descriptive strata only when each has at least30 positive and30 negative participants; otherwise mark insufficient
precision: No adequate power claim. Illustrative80 independent positive participants and10percent retained FN rate yields about3.35percentage-point SE before clustering/deferral. Actual endpoint precision requires validation data and paired errors; do not assume independent corruptions increase sample size.
freeze_gates: closest full-text literature checked and contribution wording settled
leadII waveform load and header mapping verified on development-only pilot
noise files and headers downloaded and checksummed; em waveform reserved
technical exclusions and exact resampling implementation resolved
validation role and precision audit completed before final test
institutional or competition ethics requirements checked as applicable
dated immutable protocol snapshot and amendment log created
external_validation: not included in this initial protocol; no independent cohort or wearable validation claim
pilot_rule: development-only pilot may validate file loading, numerical integrity and runtime; any design change is logged before freeze; no final-test model evaluation before lock
limitations: NSTDB em contains other artifact types as well; holding it out is a withheld source experiment, not proof of generalization to all electrode-motion faults
One small recorded noise library limits noise-donor generalization; bootstrap intervals condition on assigned noise segments
Only one fixed CNN architecture is evaluated; generality across model families is unproven
The proposed 80percent positive-retention guardrail and90percent coverage are research choices without clinical validation
Band-power features from10s recordings have limited low-frequency resolution; confirm numerical behavior in the pilot
